title: Systems Engineer II
description:
• Job Title: Systems Engineer II
  • Location: Remote

  • Duration: 6+ months
  • Pay Range: $55 - $60/hr on W2
Description:
Position Summary The Systems Engineer II supports the design, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise health information technology solutions for the Indian Health Service (Client), Division of Health Information Technology Modernization and Operations (DHITMO). This position supports the modernization of the Client electronic health record (EHR) environment, including PATH EHR and secure cloud-based data repositories such as the Four Directions Warehouse (4DW). The incumbent assists in translating clinical and operational requirements into technical solutions that enable secure, reliable, and interoperable exchange of healthcare information across enterprise systems. This role works closely with technical teams, clinical stakeholders, tribal and local site representatives, cybersecurity personnel, vendors, and program leadership to support system readiness, operational success, and long-term sustainment. Travel Required: Up to 25% Security Requirement: Ability to obtain and maintain required Client clearance Duties and Responsibilities Systems Integration and EHR Support • Support design, integration, and deployment of enterprise Health IT and EHR capabilities. • Translate clinical, business, and operational requirements into technical specifications. • Support implementation of scalable, cloud-based solutions across the federal healthcare environment. • Identify dependencies among systems, applications, interfaces, and infrastructure components. • Support development and execution of integration plans, schedules, and technical activities. Interoperability and Interface Management • Support healthcare interoperability initiatives and interface implementation efforts. • Review, coordinate, and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and related technical artifacts. • Identify, document, and track interface requirements, dependencies, and implementation status. • Maintain interface inventories and support lifecycle management of enterprise integrations. • Support data exchange initiatives using healthcare interoperability standards and technologies. Examples may include: • Health Information Exchange (HIE) • Direct Secure Messaging (DSM) • Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) • Pharmacy systems • Medical imaging systems • Dental systems • Revenue cycle systems • Patient portal integrations Data Management and Cloud Support • Support cloud-based data repositories, including environments such as the Four Directions Warehouse (4DW). • Assist with secure migration and support of historical and operational clinical data. • Support data standardization, validation, and integrity across integrated systems. • Assist with maintenance of engineering documentation, repositories, and configuration records. Testing, Validation, and Readiness • Support system characterization, functional testing, verification, and validation activities. • Develop or assist with test cases, test execution, defect tracking, and corrective action support. • Participate in test readiness reviews, operational readiness assessments, and go-live preparation. • Document test outcomes, implementation findings, and lessons learned. Stakeholder Coordination and Operational Support • Coordinate with engineering, deployment, product, cybersecurity, clinical, vendor, and program teams. • Support communication between technical teams and clinical or operational stakeholders. • Participate in site assessments, readiness reviews, and deployment support activities. • Perform troubleshooting and 2nd-level technical support for system, interface, and data issues. • Support issue escalation, change impact assessment, and engineering governance processes. Risk and Issue Management • Identify, document, and track technical risks, issues, and mitigation actions. • Support preparation of engineering status updates, risk reports, and briefing materials. • Escalate significant concerns to senior engineers and program leadership, as appropriate. Minimum Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in: • Systems Engineering • Computer Science • Information Systems • Information Technology • Health Informatics • Biomedical Engineering • Related technical discipline Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered. Experience • 2–5 years of relevant experience supporting information technology, systems engineering, or Health IT programs. • Experience supporting systems integration, interfaces, application support, or EHR-related environments. • Experience documenting technical requirements, test activities, and system processes. • Experience supporting implementation, modernization, or sustainment of technical systems. Preferred Qualifications • Experience supporting healthcare IT environments. • Familiarity with federal healthcare operations or large-scale public sector IT programs. • Experience with cloud-based systems, virtual infrastructure, or secure data environments. • Familiarity with EHR sustainment, clinical workflows, and healthcare data standardization. • Experience supporting cross-functional teams in complex deployment or modernization efforts. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Technical Knowledge Working knowledge of: • Systems engineering principles • System integration and interoperability concepts • Requirements management • Technical documentation • Software development lifecycle (SDLC) • Configuration management concepts • Cloud-based systems and virtualized infrastructure Familiarity with: • HL7 • FHIR • Interface engines • REST APIs • Identity and access management concepts • Healthcare information systems Analytical Skills • Ability to analyze technical requirements, interfaces, dependencies, and impacts. • Ability to identify technical risks, issues, and integration constraints. • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a structured environment. • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Communication Skills • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Ability to facilitate meetings and document decisions, actions, and outcomes. • Ability to prepare clear status reports, technical summaries, and briefing materials. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Typical Deliverables The Systems Engineer II may support development or maintenance of: • Interface Control Documents (ICDs) • Technical requirements documents • Integration plans and schedules • Engineering status reports • Risk and issue logs • Testing and validation documentation • Readiness assessments • Technical briefing materials • Interoperability specifications • Configuration and change documentation.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project Manager

Irvine, CA
8+ Months
Hybrid
$75/hr on W2

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex datacenter and cloud migration initiatives across enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of project management expertise, technical acumen, stakeholder management, and delivery leadership. This role will be responsible for driving infrastructure transformation projects, including on-premises datacenter migrations, cloud adoption (AWS/Azure), VMware platform transitions, and application migration programs while ensuring quality, budget, and schedule objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Delivery Management
  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of datacenter and cloud migration projects.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Track project progress, manage scope changes, and ensure timely delivery within budget.
  • Drive project governance and adherence to organizational delivery standards.
Technical Coordination & Architecture Alignment
  • Partner with solution architects, infrastructure teams, cloud engineers, and application owners to define migration strategies and technical roadmaps.
  • Coordinate technical design reviews and ensure all dependencies are identified and managed.
  • Maintain current-state and target-state architecture documentation, migration plans, and deployment schedules.
  • Facilitate migration readiness assessments and cutover planning activities.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management
  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and leadership.
  • Facilitate communication across infrastructure, networking, security, cloud, and application teams.
  • Drive decision-making, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
Agile & Delivery Governance
  • Manage Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, status reviews, and steering committee meetings.
  • Ensure teams remain aligned on priorities, deliverables, and project objectives.
Risk, Quality & Issue Management
  • Proactively identify project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies (RAID).
  • Develop mitigation and contingency plans to minimize delivery impact.
  • Coordinate testing activities including integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and post-migration validation.
  • Ensure quality standards and operational readiness requirements are met before production deployment.
Budget & Resource Management
  • Develop project budgets and resource plans in collaboration with technical teams and vendors.
  • Track project expenditures and forecast future resource requirements.
  • Monitor budget adherence and provide financial reporting to leadership.
Executive Reporting & Metrics
  • Prepare executive dashboards, status reports, and presentation materials for leadership and steering committees.
  • Track and report key performance indicators, including:
    • Schedule adherence
    • Budget performance
    • Migration success rates
    • Defect trends
    • Team velocity
    • Resource utilization
Vendor & Partner Management
  • Coordinate vendor onboarding, Statements of Work (SOWs), and contract-related activities.
  • Manage vendor deliverables, timelines, and performance metrics.
  • Ensure third-party resources align with project objectives and service expectations.
Documentation & Knowledge Management
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including:
    • Project charters
    • Migration plans
    • Architecture diagrams
    • RAID logs
    • Meeting minutes
    • Status reports
    • Cutover and rollback plans

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of project/program management experience in enterprise IT environments.
  • Proven experience managing datacenter, infrastructure, cloud, or application migration programs.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams and external vendors.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, and risks.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.

title: ASIC Design Verification Engineer
description:
Job Title – ASIC Design Verification Engineer
Duration 12 months
Location San Diego CA

About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled ASIC Design Verification Engineer to join a cutting-edge team working on high-speed mixed-signal IPs for next-generation technologies including 5G, AI/ML, IoT, compute, and automotive applications.
This role requires practical embedded systems development exerience not just narrow firmware exposure. You will work closely with hardware and software layers in Linux or real-time OS environments, building reliable and high-performance systems.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and execute pre-silicon and post-silicon verification test plans based on design specifications
  • Architect and develop UVM-based testbenches using SystemVerilog
  • Implement SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), test cases, and coverage models
  • Perform debugging and coverage closure to ensure design quality
  • Work closely with design, analog, modeling, and SoC integration teams
  • Support PHY-level verification, subsystem integration, and post-silicon validation
  • Contribute to VIP development for SerDes/PHY components (plus)
Required Skills
  • Strong expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM methodology
  • Experience with ASIC verification tools such as VCS, Xcelium, ModelSim/Questa
  • Knowledge of formal verification tools (JasperGold, VC Formal, 0-In)
  • Hands-on experience with SVA, debugging, and coverage-driven verification
  • Solid understanding of high-speed interface protocols:
    • PCIe, USB 3.x/4
    • MIPI (CSI/DSI)
    • DDR / LPDDR
  • Experience with gate-level simulation (GLS) and low-power verification (UPF) is a plus
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in mixed-signal verification (ADC, DAC, PLL, sensors)
  • Exposure to SerDes / PHY verification
  • Experience in SoC/subsystem integration
  • Proficiency in Python or Perl scripting
  • Hands-on experience with VIP development is highly desirable
Education
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Why Join Us
  • Work on next-gen technologies in 5G, AI/ML, and automotive
  • Be part of a high-impact, innovation-driven team
  • Opportunity to work across full silicon lifecycle
